artworks.title: Crane Harbor
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium desktop wallpaper for the Porcelain Ink theme in a coordinated three-monitor collection. Reference image is a STYLE AND PALETTE reference only, not an edit target. Create an original, full-bleed wide 16:9 landscape artwork at the highest available resolution, ideally 3840x2160. Traditional East Asian sumi-e ink wash and meticulous charcoal brush drawing on luminous warm ivory rice paper, delicate natural paper grain, muted grey mist, rich near-black pine silhouettes, very restrained cinnabar vermilion accents. Gallery-quality hand-painted detail, depth and beautiful atmospheric negative space. Absolutely NO interface, windows, menus, panels, icons, cursor, border, typography, lettering, calligraphy, signatures, stamps, seals or watermarks. Art only, with no text of any kind. Avoid photographic or plastic 3D rendering, saturated multi-color foliage, generic vector illustration. This is the LEFT monitor painting. A windswept black pine and a few vermilion maple leaves frame the far left and bottom, a small traditional pagoda perched on a rocky promontory in the lower left, beyond it an expansive pale lake with a small wooden sailboat, distant layered karst peaks dissolving gently into ivory mist toward the right. A few tiny cranes above the water. The top center and right half have breathable warm paper and delicate mist; no sun disk in this painting. Asymmetrical Japanese landscape composition, intimate dark foreground against light vast distance. The lake horizon sits near the lower middle. Match the reference's refined ivory / charcoal / red world, not its UI.
